info.summary: Choose an area and a type of business and get a short list with the reason each one is worth a look. You decide who to contact.

direction.concept: A district map from above with a radar sweep and dropping pins

scenes.say: Stop guessing. Your next client is one district away.
scenes.title: Stop guessing

scenes.say: Walking around and searching by hand takes your whole day.
scenes.title: Searching takes all day

scenes.say: Our lead agent starts with two choices, the area and the type of business.
scenes.title: Two choices

scenes.say: It searches, reads the public details, and checks what each place is missing online.
scenes.title: It does the digging

scenes.say: Then it brings you a short list, with the reason each one is worth a look.
scenes.title: A short list

scenes.say: You stay in charge. You decide who to contact, and what to say.
scenes.title: You decide

caption:
Stop guessing. Your next client is one district away.

Choose an area and a type of business, get a short list, and decide who to contact.

Comment LEADS and we will send you the details.
